annotations.title: One inbox for comments, replies, mentions, reviews and DMs

description: Use this when the user asks what they need to reply to, about new comments or DMs, or how people are responding. It lists everything people said to this brand, across every connected channel: Facebook and Instagram comments, Threads replies and mentions, YouTube comments, TikTok comments, LinkedIn Page comments, Google Business reviews, Bluesky replies and mentions, and X mentions — plus DIRECT MESSAGES on Meta (Messenger and Instagram Direct), Instagram, Bluesky, X, Telegram, WhatsApp, SMS (Twilio, Telnyx), iMessage (Sendblue, LoopMessage), LINE, Slack and Discord. Discord messages that mention the Hermoso bot or reply to it, and replies to the brand's Outlook email, plus email to the brand's own domain (the domain inbox). Support tickets too: the open conversations in the brand's Intercom inbox. Phone calls too: the calls the brand's AI voice agents (Vapi, Retell AI, ElevenLabs, Telnyx AI) answered or placed, with their transcripts, read only. Each item carries a composite id you hand straight to reply_to_inbox_item. A channel that is not connected is skipped and named; a channel that FAILS to read is named in `notes` rather than dropped, so a short list is never mistaken for a quiet week. Each DM conversation folds to ONE item (the newest thing the other person said). Messenger and Instagram DMs need no argument; each has a messageKind (text, story_mention, story_reply, share, image, video...), a spoken summary, and unavailable:true when Meta withholds the content. Bluesky DMs need conversationId (list_bluesky_convos). X DMs and Telegram need no argument and read EVERY X account and every Telegram bot on the brand (the last 30 days on X, 24 hours on Telegram); each item's `account` is the one it reached. WhatsApp needs no argument: Hermoso keeps the last 48 hours of each WhatsApp conversation (WhatsApp has no message history to read back), and each item carries windowOpen, its last few messages (recent) and whether a free reply is still allowed. LINE needs no argument either (kept 7 days), nor do Slack DMs (every direct message people sent the Hermoso app) or Discord mentions (the server's busiest channels). Discord DMs are read one member at a time, because Discord gives a bot no list of its DMs: pass discordMember (the member's Discord id). TikTok and LinkedIn comments are read per post: pass tiktokVideoId / linkedinPostUrn. Free on every channel except X: X mentions cost credits per item returned, and X DMs cost credits per message X has not already been paid for today (a repeat read with nothing new is free).

account.description: Only items received by this account of the brand: its id, @handle, Page name, Slack workspace, WhatsApp number, X account or Telegram bot (each item's `account`). For a brand with several accounts on one channel.

conversationId.description: Restrict DMs to one conversation (from list_meta_conversations, list_bluesky_convos or list_x_dms). Required for Bluesky DMs; on X and Telegram it reads that one conversation (an id list_inbox gave, or a list_x_dms conversation id).

discordMember.description: Include the Hermoso bot's Discord DM with this member (their Discord member id).

linkedinPostUrn.description: Include the comments on this LinkedIn Page post (its urn, as post_to_linkedin_page returned). LinkedIn reads comments per post.

pageId.description: Facebook Page id (list_meta_pages) when the brand has several Pages connected: reads that Page's Messenger and Instagram DMs and comments only. Omit to read every connected Page.

postId.description: Restrict Facebook/Instagram to one post or media id (Meta reads comments per post).

since.description: only what is NEW since your last call: pass the sinceCursor the previous answer gave. Polling? whats_new covers every channel in one call and reads no platform

sources.description: Limit to these sources: facebook, instagram, threads, meta_dm, instagram_dm, meta_webhook, facebook_review, instagram_mention, threads_mention, youtube, google_business, x, bluesky, bluesky_mention, bluesky_dm, x_dm, telegram_dm, whatsapp, imessage, sms, call, line, intercom, tiktok, linkedin, slack_dm, discord, discord_dm, domain_mail, email. Omit for every connected channel.

tiktokVideoId.description: Include the comments on this TikTok post (its id, from list_tiktok_videos). TikTok reads comments per post.

unansweredOnly.description: Only items with no reply from the brand yet.
